CITY OF SIGNAL HILL
  2175 Cherry Avenue • Signal Hill, California 90755-3799

  MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING
  SIGNAL HILL CITY COUNCIL
  August 26, 2025

A Regular Meeting of the Signal Hill City Council was held in-person in the Council Chamber
on August 26, 2025.

(1)  CALL TO ORDER – 6:00 P.M.

(2)  ROLL CALL

  PRESENT:  MAYOR KEIR JONES
  VICE MAYOR TINA HANSEN
  COUNCIL MEMBER CHARLIE HONEYCUTT
  COUNCIL MEMBER LORI WOODS
  ABSENT:  COUNCIL MEMBER ROBERT COPELAND

(3)  CLOSED SESSION

  a.  A CLOSED SESSION WILL BE HELD PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE
  SECTION 54956.8.

  CONFERENCE WITH REAL PROPERTY NEGOTIATORS

  PROPERTY: APPROXIMATELY 1.6 ACRES OF CITY-OWNED, INDUSTRIAL
  OPEN SPACE ADJACENT TO I-405 FREEWAY; APN: 7212-001-933.

  AGENCY NEGOTIATORS: MAYOR AND CITY MANAGER.

  NEGOTIATING PARTIES:  CITY OF SIGNAL HILL; CLEAR CHANNEL
  OUTDOOR HOLDINGS, INCORPORATED; AND THEIR AUTHORIZED
  AGENTS OR REPRESENTATIVES.

  UNDER NEGOTIATION: PRICE AND TERMS OF PAYMENT.

  City Council Minutes of a Regular Meeting
  August 26, 2025
  Page 1 of 6
 (4)  PUBLIC BUSINESS FROM THE FLOOR ON CLOSED SESSION ITEMS

  There was no public business from the floor.
(5)  RECESSED TO CLOSED SESSION AT 6:01 P.M.

  It was moved by COUNCIL MEMBER WOODS and seconded by VICE MAYOR
  HANSEN to recess to Closed Session.
(6)  RECONVENED REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.

  Mayor Jones reconvened the meeting and led the audience in the Pledge of
  Allegiance.
(7)  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

(8)  CLOSED SESSION REPORT

  The City Attorney reported on the closed session item; there was no reportable action
  taken.
(9)  PUBLIC BUSINESS FROM THE FLOOR ON ITEMS NOT LISTED ON THE AGENDA

  Signal Hill resident Scott Wilcox thanked the Police Department for excellent customer
  service he recently received.
(10)  PRESENTATIONS

  a.  POLICE CHIEF BRAD KENNEALLY WILL SWEAR IN NEWLY PROMOTED
  CAPTAIN KELLI CRIGLER.
  Chief of Police Brad Kenneally swore in the new Police Captain, Kelli Crigler.

  b.  THE GREATER LOS ANGELES COUNTY VECTOR CONTROL DISTRICT
  WILL MAKE A PRESENTATION TO SHARE INFORMATION ABOUT THE
  AGENCY AND THE SERVICES IT PROVIDES. THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY
  VECTOR CONTROL DISTRICT’S GOAL IS TO ENSURE COUNCIL MEMBERS
  AND THEIR CONSTITUENTS ARE AWARE OF THE SERVICES AVAILABLE
  TO THEM AND WHO TO CONTACT FOR MOSQUITO AND VECTOR
  CONTROL ASSISTANCE.
  Greater Los Angeles County Vector Control District Assistant General Manager
  Allison Costa presented agenda item 10b.

  c.  THE SIGNAL HILL COMMUNITY FOUNDATION, IN PARTNERSHIP WITH
  THE CITY, HOSTED FOUR CONCERTS IN THE PARK FOR THE 2025
  SUMMER SEASON. MAYOR JONES WILL RECOGNIZE THIS YEAR’S
  SPONSORS.
  Mayor Jones presented agenda item 10c.

  City Council Minutes of a Regular Meeting
  August 26, 2025
  Page 2 of 6
   d.  PRESENTATION OF THE NEW SPOTLIGHT ON SMALL BUSINESS VIDEO
  SERIES FEATURING THE WINE COUNTRY. THE OWNER, RANDALL
  “RANDY” KEMNER, WILL ACCEPT A CERTIFICATE OF RECOGNITION.
  Mayor Jones presented agenda item 10d.

(11)  CITY MANAGER REPORTS

  a.  REQUEST FOR TEMPORARY PERSONNEL ADJUSTMENT IN THE
  COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT TO SUPPORT PLANNED
  STAFFING TRANSITIONS
  Community Development Director Colleen Doan and Human Resources
  Manager Patricia Ahumada provided a presentation on this item. It was moved
  by COUNCIL MEMBER WOODS and seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER
  HONEYCUTT to approve an additional full time equivalent (FTE) employee in
  the Community Development Department through June 30, 2026.
  The following vote resulted:
  AYES:  MAYOR JONES
  VICE MAYOR HANSEN
  COUNCIL MEMBER HONEYCUTT
  COUNCIL MEMBER WOODS
  NOES:  NONE
  ABSENT:  COUNCIL MEMBER COPELAND
  ABSTAIN:  NONE
  b.  PUBLIC WORKS CONTRACT  WITH KORMEX CONSTRUCTION,
  INCORPORATED FOR THE STREET TREE PLANTING PROJECT (PROJECT
  NO.90.25012)
  Contracts Manager Margarita Beltran provided a presentation on this item and
  responded to a question from the City Council regarding residents who may
  want to request opting out of this parkway work. The City Council also expressed
  appreciation for this work to enhance the community. It was moved by COUNCIL
  MEMBER WOODS and seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER HONEYCUTT to
  authorize the City Manager to enter into a Public Works Contract with Kormex
  Construction, Incorporated for the Street Tree Planting Project, for a term of 6
  months and a not to exceed contract amount of $365,500, in a form approved by
  the City Attorney; and authorize a 10% contingency of $36,550 and up to a 60
  calendar day extension to accommodate additional scope of work, scope of
  work changes, or unforeseen conditions, to be utilized if approved by the Public
  Works Director, for a total construction budget of $402,050.

  City Council Minutes of a Regular Meeting
  August 26, 2025
  Page 3 of 6
   The following vote resulted:
  AYES:  MAYOR JONES
  VICE MAYOR HANSEN
  COUNCIL MEMBER HONEYCUTT
  COUNCIL MEMBER WOODS
  NOES:  NONE
  ABSENT:  COUNCIL MEMBER COPELAND
  ABSTAIN:  NONE
  c.  FINAL ACCEPTANCE OF THE PANORAMA PROMENADE SLOPE
  LANDSCAPE PROJECT AND APPROVAL OF A COST SHARING
  AGREEMENT WITH SIGNAL HILL PETROLEUM
  Public Works Director/City Engineer Thomas Bekele provided a presentation on
  this item. The City Council expressed appreciation to staff for this conscientious
  repair work, the speed at which it was completed, and presenting cost solutions;
  working with the Federal Emergency Management Agency; and to Signal Hill
  Petroleum for partnering on the cost of the work. It was moved by VICE MAYOR
  HANSEN and seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER WOODS to accept the work in
  conformance with the plans and specifications for the Panorama Promenade
  Slope Landscape Project in accordance with the contract entered into between
  Estate Design and Construction, Incorporated and the City of Signal Hill, and
  authorize the City Manager to execute the Notice of Completion; direct staff to
  record the Notice of Completion with the Los Angeles County Registrar
  Recorder’s office; and authorize the City Manager to execute a Cost Sharing
  Agreement with Signal Hill Petroleum to formalize its contribution of seventy
  percent (70%) of the total costs associated with Phase II of the Panorama Slope
  Landscape Project, in a form approved by the City Attorney.
  The following vote resulted:
  AYES:  MAYOR JONES
  VICE MAYOR HANSEN
  COUNCIL MEMBER HONEYCUTT
  COUNCIL MEMBER WOODS
  NOES:  NONE
  ABSENT:  COUNCIL MEMBER COPELAND
  ABSTAIN:  NONE

(12)  CONSENT CALENDAR

  a.  FINAL ACCEPTANCE OF PHASE I SIDEWALK REPAIR PROJECT (PROJECT
  NO. 90.25007) PURSUANT TO THE PUBLIC WORKS CONTRACT WITH
  GENTRY GENERAL ENGINEERING, INCORPORATED
  b.  LOS ANGELES GATEWAY REGION INTEGRATED REGIONAL WATER

  City Council Minutes of a Regular Meeting
  August 26, 2025
  Page 4 of 6
   MANAGEMENT AUTHORITY AMENDED AND RESTATED JOINT EXERCISE
  OF POWER AUTHORITY AGREEMENT
  c.  FEE AND ALCOHOL PROHIBITION WAIVER REQUEST FOR THE SIGNAL
  HILL COMMUNITY FOUNDATION ANNUAL FALL FUNDRAISING EVENT
  d.  APPROVAL AND ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION FINALIZING THE CITY’S
  LOCAL HAZARD MITIGATION PLAN
  e.  PROPOSED ACCEPTANCE OF THE EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT
  PERFORMANCE GRANT (EMPG) 24 AND ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION
  APPROVING BUDGET AMENDMENT
  f.  RESOLUTION APPROVING THE 2024 MILITARY EQUIPMENT ANNUAL
  REPORT AND RENEWING ORDINANCE NO. 2022-06-1535
  g.  CONTRACT AMENDMENT REGISTER DATED AUGUST 26, 2025

  h.  SCHEDULE OF INVESTMENTS AND MONTHLY TRANSACTION REPORT

  i.  WARRANT REGISTER PRESENTED AUGUST 26, 2025

  j.  APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES

  It was moved by COUNCIL MEMBER WOODS and seconded by VICE MAYOR
  HANSEN to approve the Consent Calendar.
  The following vote resulted:
  AYES:  MAYOR JONES
  VICE MAYOR HANSEN
  COUNCIL MEMBER HONEYCUTT
  COUNCIL MEMBER WOODS
  NOES:  NONE
  ABSENT:  COUNCIL MEMBER COPELAND
  ABSTAIN:  NONE

(13)  COUNCIL AGENDA--NEW BUSINESS

  Council Member Woods reported that she attended the recent California Contract
  Cities Association (CCCA) Board of Directors meeting at the Los Angeles County
  Arboretum and Botanic Garden and indicated that she is unable to attend the
  upcoming CCCA conference.

  Mayor Jones reported that he was recently appointed to the Gateway Cities Affordable
  Housing Trust Board of Directors and that a new Signal Hill Community Foundation
  event, "A Night of Magic", is scheduled for October 30, 2025 at 6:30 p.m. on the Signal
  Point Terrace.

  City Council Minutes of a Regular Meeting
  August 26, 2025
  Page 5 of 6
   It was moved by MAYOR JONES and seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER WOODS to
  agendize a discussion of establishing an annual Jessie Nelson Day of Remembrance
  to be held in April.

  Council Member Woods, and the entire City Council, congratulated City Clerk Daritza
  Gonzalez (now Perez) on her recent nuptials.
(14)  ADJOURNMENT
  It was moved by VICE MAYOR HANSEN and seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER
  HONEYCUTT to adjourn tonight's meeting to the next Regular meeting of the City
  Council on September 9, 2025 at 7:00 p.m.

MAYOR JONES adjourned the meeting at 8:10 p.m.

_____________________________
KEIR JONES
MAYOR

Attest:

_____________________________
DARITZA PEREZ
CITY CLERK

Council Member Woods, and the entire City Council, congratulated City Clerk Daritza Gonzalez (now Perez) on her recent nuptials.
